rows.jyutping: jau4 dei6 zat1 hok6 gok3 dou6 tai2
rows.note: Use this as the natural spoken way to discuss something from a geology viewpoint.

example.english: Geologically, this mountain is very unusual.
example.traditional: 由地質學角度睇，呢座山好特別。
example.jyutping: jau4 dei6 zat1 hok6 gok3 dou6 tai2 ne1 zo6 saan1 hou2 dak6 bit6

rows.jyutping: hai2 dei6 zat1 gwo3 cing4 jap6 min6
rows.note: Use this when something happens as part of a geological process, rather than simply being discussed from a geology viewpoint.

example.english: These rocks formed slowly, geologically speaking, through a natural process.
example.traditional: 呢啲岩石喺地質過程入面慢慢形成。
example.jyutping: ni1 di1 ngaam4 sek6 hai2 dei6 zat1 gwo3 cing4 jap6 min6 maan6 maan6 jing4 sing4
